nature.method: WorldClim 2.1 10-min (elev/bio1/bio12) sampled at territory centroid; climate/soil/relief/fertility/water/forest/cultivable re-derived by build_natural_geography formulas
nature.note: aplicado por tools/apply_real_climate.py; territórios com centróide em água mantêm valores sintéticos (test)

agriculture.method: trapezoidal climate/water/soil suitability per crop, fed by real altitude/temp/precip

deposits.source: USGS MRDS WFS compact (dep_id, site, status, commodity, point) + curated supplements
deposits.quality: real location, estimated attributes; curated where MRDS lacks coordinates
deposits.note: quantity/quality/depth/cost estimated deterministically from sites and status
